blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Jose Rizal University overcame the absence of star Chris Hubilla in its 81-78 win over Lyceum in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament at San Juan Arena on Tuesday. With Hubilla out indefinitely after going down with a partial MCL tear in the team’s previous game against San Beda, the Heavy Bombers turned to another dependable sniper in Sanlea Peñaverde. READ: NCAA: Mangubat, Hubilla settling into bigger roles at JRU Peñaverde exploded for 22 points along with five assists, four steals and three rebounds for JRU, which got back into the win column.
